from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

base = Path('/home/angus/build-qoco-gpu-device-ir-v116')
assert not base.exists(), 'Never overwrite a frozen runtime'
runtime = Path('/home/angus/cudss-isolated-0.8.0.10/nvidia/cu12')
link = runtime / 'lib/libcudss.so'
if not link.exists():
    link.symlink_to('libcudss.so.0')
flags = ['--gather', '--correct-stopping', '--checked-cudss-abi',
         '--queued-operators', '--device-cone-reductions', '--values-only-updates',
         '--device-numeric-updates', '--device-scalar-reductions', '--batched-stopping',
         '--batched-iteration-scalars', '--device-step-control', '--setup-lifetimes',
         '--trajectory-ordering', '--trajectory-tree', '--reset-solve-state','--device-io','--gpu-kkt','--gpu-transposes','--lazy-transpose-mirrors','--deferred-transposes','--metric-graphs','--fused-kkt-product','--device-combined-rhs']
cmake = '/home/angus/spacecraft-trajectory-optmiser/.venv/bin/cmake'
with Path('build/performance/native-checks/qoco-v116-build.log').open('w') as log:
    if not (base / 'source').exists():
        subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_gpu.py', '--source',
            '/home/angus/spacecraft-trajectory-optmiser/_upstream/qoco-g4',
            '--destination', str(base / 'source'), *flags], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_device_ir.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_device_control.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_device_direction.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_factor_graph.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/gpu/prepare_qoco_ir_cache.py','--destination',str(base/'source')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run([cmake, '-S', str(base / 'source'), '-B', str(base / 'build'), '-G', 'Ninja',
        '-DQOCO_ALGEBRA_BACKEND=cuda', '-DQOCO_BUILD_TYPE=Release', '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release',
        '-DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER=/usr/local/cuda-12.8/bin/nvcc', '-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120',
        '-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS=-I' + str(runtime / 'include'), '-DCUDSS_LIB=' + str(link),
        '-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-Werror=implicit-function-declaration', '-DBUILD_QOCO_DEMO=OFF'],
        stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    subprocess.run([cmake, '--build', str(base / 'build'), '--target', 'qoco', '-j', '3'],
        stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
print('Built GPU controlled IR v116',flush=True)

import shutil
(base/'final').mkdir()
for path in (base/'build').rglob('libqoco.so'):
    shutil.copy2(path,base/'final/libqoco.so')
(base/'final/libqoco.so').chmod(0o555)
print('Frozen QOCO116',flush=True)

  rows.append(dict(variant=variant,version=version,flags=flags,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr,probes=probes))
  out.write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

import json,runpy,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
import os
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.low_thrust import ScvxSettings,solve_leg,certify_leg
fixture=runpy.run_path('tests/test_gtoc12_gpu_discretisation.py')
rows=[]
for repeat in range(2):
    start=time.perf_counter()
    solution=solve_leg(fixture['synthetic_boundary'](),ScvxSettings(discretisation_backend='cuda',
        assembly_backend='cuda',convex_solver_backend='qoco',outer_loop_backend=os.environ['SCVX_OUTER'],max_iterations=30,time_limit_s=30))
    seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
    certificate=certify_leg(solution)
    rows.append(dict(warmup=repeat==0,seconds=seconds,status=solution.status,mass=solution.final_mass_kg,
        qualified=bool(solution.converged and certificate.within_tolerance and abs(solution.final_mass_kg-2445.3111007852112)<=1e-5),
        certificate=asdict(certificate),outer_transfer_bytes=solution.outer_transfer_bytes,seed_backend=solution.seed_backend,reports=solution.solver_reports,history=solution.history))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(rows[-1]['qualified'],rows[-1]['seconds'],flush=True)
